Privacy Notice

This notice explains what information Tonyana, the Subconscious Specialist LLC receives through this website, how we use it, who helps us handle it, and the choices you have.

Effective date: November 9, 2026

What We Collect

Apart from the technical information described under "Other Things This Website Uses" below, we only collect what you choose to send us. When you use the contact form, we receive your name, your email address, and your message. If you email us directly, we receive whatever is in your email.

This website does not run analytics scripts, advertising, or tracking cookies, and it does not build a profile of you.

How We Use It

We use your name, email address, and message only to reply to you and, if you book a session, to arrange it with you. We do not sell, rent, or trade your information. We do not share it with anyone else, except the services that deliver it to us (described below), or when the law requires it.

Who Helps Us Handle It

  • Form delivery: our contact form is delivered by FormSubmit (formsubmit.co), a third-party service that forwards your message to our email inbox. FormSubmit handles your submission under its own privacy policy (opens in new tab).
  • Spam protection: to block spam, FormSubmit may ask you to complete a reCAPTCHA check, which is provided by Google.
  • Email: your message is stored in our email account, which is hosted by our email provider.

If you would rather not use the form, you can email us directly at libratarot@hotmail.com.

No Mailing List, Nothing to Unsubscribe From

We do not have a mailing list or newsletter, and we do not send marketing emails. Contacting us does not sign you up for anything. The only emails you will receive from us are personal replies about your inquiry or session. If you would like us to stop emailing you, just reply and say so, and we will.

Seeing, Correcting, or Deleting Your Information

You can ask us at any time what information we have from you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete your messages and contact details, by emailing libratarot@hotmail.com. We keep your messages only as long as we need them to help you and to keep a record of our conversation. When you ask, we will delete them from our email, unless we need to keep a record for legal or tax reasons, and let you know when it is done. FormSubmit's handling of its own copy is covered by its privacy policy.

Other Things This Website Uses

  • Fonts: the text on this website uses Google Fonts. To display them, your browser connects to Google's servers, which receive your IP address.
  • Animation setting: if you press "Pause animations", that choice is saved in your own browser so it is remembered between pages. It is never sent to us.
  • Hosting: like most websites, our web host may keep standard server logs, such as IP addresses and the pages requested, to keep the site running and secure.
  • Links: our Facebook, Instagram, and Voxer links take you to those companies' websites, which have their own privacy policies.

Tracking and "Do Not Track"

We do not track your activity across other websites, and we do not allow advertising networks or other companies to track your activity on this site over time. The only outside services this site uses are the ones described above (Google Fonts, and FormSubmit with Google reCAPTCHA when you send a message), and they handle the technical information they receive under their own policies. Because we do not track you, this website works the same way whether or not your browser sends a "Do Not Track" signal.

Changes to This Notice

If we make changes to this notice, we will post the new version on this page and update the effective date at the top.

Contact

Questions about this notice or your information can be sent to libratarot@hotmail.com.
